site.title: Mara Quell — architecture and structure
site.description: Mara Quell designs thin concrete shells, timber roofs and rammed earth buildings. Selected work 2009–2024, the practice, and a form to start a project.

footer.p_1: Build the shape that carries itself, and the building will be lighter in every sense.
footer.p_2_html: Mara Quell is a fictional studio. Template powered by Formgong. All rights reserved ©2026

top.p_11: Mara Quell is an architect and engineer who builds with as little material as a structure allows: concrete shells a few centimetres thin, timber roofs that hold themselves up by their shape, and walls of earth taken from the site. The buildings are for everyday use, and they are beautiful because they are efficient, not in spite of it.
top.p_12: Every project starts with the structure. Find the shape that carries the load, and the rooms, the light and the budget usually follow. The studio designs and calculates every building it draws.

practice.p_4: The studio is small on purpose: four architects and engineers who draw, calculate and visit the site themselves, so the idea of a building survives all the way to the last bolt.
practice.img_5_alt: The studio: drawing tables and shell models
practice.p_7: Mara Quell trained as a civil engineer before she studied architecture. She teaches structures two days a week and writes about thin shells and low-carbon building. The studio has built in Portugal, Spain and Morocco.

statement.h2_1: Where the structure is the architecture

notes.p_1: “A roof that is thin because its shape carries it is cheaper, lighter and quieter than one that is thick because nobody asked the shape. We do not add beauty at the end. We find it in the calculation, or we do not find it.”

contact.p_2: Tell us what you want to build and where. We reply within three working days, and the first conversation is free.
contact.text_19: Your message is with the studio. We reply within three working days.

duo.p_1: Most clients come with a site, a budget and a doubt about whether something unusual can be built for it. Usually it can.
duo.p_2: We work across Portugal and Spain, and further away when a project needs a structural idea more than a local office. Fees are fixed per stage and agreed before we start drawing.
